svg.aria-label: Finite-ramp joint fit, residuals, arm amplitudes and observation-window comparison for constructed data. Panel c shows suppression of original arm moduli when a hold is treated as a step. Panel d compares equal initial moduli but different long-time plateaus. Points are constructed observations; lines are model responses.
